unit.title: The Future, Personal Goals and B1 Integration

theory.title: Integrated B1 communication challenge
theory.explanation: Use the language from the whole course to understand information, explain experiences, solve problems, express opinions and plan ahead. Focus on communicating clearly and choosing accurate forms in context.
theory.tip: Prioriza claridad, coherencia y precisión; combina vocabulario y gramática de distintas unidades.

content.passage: A group of learners took part in a final B1 project. They had to plan an event, communicate with local partners and present their results. Although the preparation was challenging, they managed to solve problems together. One learner said that if she had the opportunity, she would work abroad. By next year, she hopes to have achieved her goal of using English confidently at work. The group agreed that the more they practised, the easier communication became.

items.prompt: Describe what you have learned during this course.
items.modelAnswer: During this course, I have become more confident using English in everyday situations. I can describe experiences, explain opinions and ask for information more politely. I have also learned how to talk about plans, solve problems and work with other people. Some grammar points were difficult at first, but regular practice helped me improve. In the future, I would like to use English more often at work and when travelling.

content.audioTranscript: A: How have you found the course? B: Very useful. I've developed new skills and gained more confidence. A: What has helped you most? B: The practical experience and regular practice have made a difference. A: Have you shared your opinions in class? B: Yes, and we've solved several problems together. A: What are your plans for the future? B: I want to achieve my goals and continue making progress.
